look: Moonstone Ursine, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Moonstone Ravagers family: ancient giant bear wearing a pale moonstone crown. Family anatomy: hulking bear-like predators with owlish facial discs and moonstone claws. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are milky moonstone. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, vivid sweeping ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
